headline: Optimism Over Hormuz Reopening Fades… Won-Dollar Exchange Rate Contested Around 1430 Won [FX Briefing]
summary: The won-dollar exchange rate is expected to trade around 1,430 won under slight upward pressure. The one-month NDF settled at 1,422.5 won in New York overnight.
why: The won-dollar rate reflects demand for dollars against South Korea's currency. Oil import costs and risk sentiment influence it.

impacts.name: Won-dollar exchange rate
impacts.why: Fading Hormuz reopening hopes add slight upward pressure on the dollar against the won.
